mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_course (student_id, course_id, semester) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{semester})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM student_course WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND semester = #{semester}
mapper.select: SELECT sc.*, c.name AS course_name, c.teacher_name, c.room, c.subject, DATE_FORMAT(sc.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS enroll_time FROM student_course sc LEFT JOIN course c ON sc.course_id = c.id WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY sc.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_course WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND semester = #{semester}
SELECT * FROM student_course WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND semester = #{semester}
